_about: An example project template. Copied to .workflow/ask-templates/ in a project, it adds the dependency-review template; dependency-review.spec.json uses it.
name: dependency-review
use: Each dependency the update would change: keep it, take the update, or replace it.

options.label: Keep the version we have
options.why: No change now; it comes back at the next update.

options.label: Take the update
options.why: The new version goes in with this change, and its tests run.

options.label: Replace it
options.why: A different package does the job; say which in the note.
